max_conversations.description: The maximum number of customer conversations the user can handle simultaneously

phones.description: List of the phones (SIP phones or verified mobile numbers) linked to the user's profile that can used for call forwarding.

phnum.description: The actual phone number that is used to forward incoming calls. Applied to non-SIP phones.

phone_type.description: The type of phone i.e. sip or regular

phone_name.description: User's chosen name for the phone number

receive_calls.description: Flag that indicates if incoming calls to the user should be sent to this phone. In case of SIP phones, this field is not applicable.

verified.description: Read only field Flag that indicates if the phone is verified or not

language.description: Three letter ISO code of the user's account language.

language_id.description: An internal numeric code of the user's account language.

title.description: The user's job title for example, Sales Engineer, CEO, etc.

type.description: Privilege level of user i.e. admin or regular.

user_lname.description: The last name of the user.

location.description: User's location details such as country, area code and timezone.

country.description: The user's country. Has an affect on how the user dials phone numbers.

timezone_id.description: An internal numeric identifier for the user's timezone.
